cases.title: SC-2610-103 Ferry Road, loss 2.44 percent
cases.text:
THE STOCK COUNT
Count: SC-2610-103
Store: S-103, Rowanmere Market Ferry Road
Period: 2026-10, counted 2026-10-31
Lines counted: 60
Sales value: USD 15,380.37
Loss units: 105
Loss value: USD 375.27
Loss percent: 2.44
THE TOLERANCE
Document: Stock Loss Tolerance, version 1.4
SL-1: A store's loss for a period is beyond tolerance when its loss value is more than 1.5 percent of its sales value. A store at exactly 1.5 percent is within tolerance.
SL-2: A line's loss for a period, all counted stores together, is beyond tolerance when its loss value is more than 2.5 percent of its sales value. A line at exactly 2.5 percent is within tolerance.
SL-3: Loss is the units the books say should be there minus the units counted. Loss value and sales value are both at the shelf price, tax included.
Not decided by the tolerance: A store or a line beyond tolerance is one for the loss prevention lead to look into. The tolerance does not say why stock was lost: waste, damage, a counting error, a delivery booked in wrongly and theft all look the same in a count. It does not say that any colleague or any customer did anything wrong.
